A [b]rainbow[/b] is an optical phenomenon in which a [[rainbow arch]] forms in the sky due to refraction of light off rain droplets. This causes all the visible colors of light to be displayed.

Rainbow colors are commonly used in artwork and design, and furry art is definitely no exception. Rainbows are associated with many things, such as [[LGBT Pride]], childhood, peace, religious meanings, and much more.

[b]Flowers[/b], also sometimes referred to as [b]blossoms[/b], are the reproductive part of flowering [[plant|plants]]. 

All flowering plants are part of a group known as Angiosperm. A flower's appearance can change wildly from plant to plant, but generally they consist of a group of colorful, ruffly oval shaped petals radially mounted around the end of a stem.

This tag should be used whenever a picture features a flower,  for example, stuck behind one's ear, or on a flowering tree when in bloom. This also applies to characters who have visible flowers on them or are, themselves, a flower such as [[flowey_the_flower|Flowey]] from [i][[Undertale]][/i].

Note, however, if the plant has not yet blossomed, use [[bud_(flower)]] instead.
